blind.description: A stylized cluster of hexagonal crystal prisms embedded in a dark grey-brown rocky mound. The majority of the crystals are bright purple and magenta with hand-painted faceted highlights, arranged in varying heights around a tall central crystal. Nestled along one edge of the rock base are two smaller golden-yellow crystals. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and faceted in a clean stylized art style. The underside of the rocky mound sits flat on the floor, and all components are seamlessly integrated with no floating shards or unpainted regions.
blind.from_above: A rounded rocky base with an array of pointed, faceted crystal caps radiating outward from a large central purple crystal, accompanied by two small yellow-orange crystal points on the lower-left edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3 to 3.5 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3 feet wide.
